inputs.name: GET.url
inputs.description: The request URL passed by SvelteKit to GET. Its hostname gates access: only 127.0.0.1, localhost, and [::1] receive the analytics snapshot; other hostnames receive an unavailable response.

outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: Resolves to the HTTP Response returned for this request. A non-loopback hostname returns JSON { status: 'unavailable' } with status 403; loopback requests return the siteProcesses snapshot with cache-control: no-store and status 200 when its status is available, or 503 otherwise.
